name: Chaffinch
lateFeature: Bold white wing bars, long pale-edged primaries and divided tail
anatomyNotes: Blue-grey cap, rich rusty pink breast, green-brown rump and paired white wing bars. Swept long wing points left; the pale outer tail vane is kept distinct from paper.
coordinateNote: Logical1000x750; sourceCrop/destRect xywh; boxes x0y0x1y1; ellipse and directionAngle radians; paint directions unit vectors.
registrationMethod: Canonical source inspected visually; manual species silhouette, local paint polygons and gesture paths; no source bitmap edits.
feetRegistrationNote: Manual source-following leg/toe centreline ribbons; feetPolys are a union of narrow round-ended stroke envelopes, not broad feet boxes. Tiny source-perch crossings beneath toes can remain in the original art.
branchCutoutNote: Dense branch-only silhouette refined along inward normals by narrow-band source colour/paper sampling, with explicit pale-plumage protection. Full portrait registration and painting score unchanged; canonical pixels untouched.
